name: SliverFixedExtentList
desc: A list component of the Sliver family, which constructs child components through a delegate and can specify the height of the item. It is commonly used in CustomScrollView.

fields.name: itemExtent
fields.desc: The extent the children are forced to have in the main axis.

nodes.name: Basic Usage of SliverFixedExtentList
desc: 【itemExtent】: Forced length in the main axis   【double】
